reply.text:
Soreness that they want to train around is a training request, not an injury, so this is a patch. Wrist is not one of the limitation values, so I can't map it; the closest honest mapping is to avoid those movements. The request names heavy push-ups and front squats for today, which is a single-session change, so I return a dayFocus rather than a program. The athlete did not name a focus, so I use "full body".

{"route": "patch", "say": "Got it, we'll keep the heavy push-ups and front squats off today's session.", "patch": {"dayFocus": "full body", "limitations": ["no_overhead"], "avoid": ["heavy push-ups", "front squats"]}}
